titleStmt.title: Shiji 史记 · 秦庄襄王元年: introductions

div.p: The Basic Annals for 249 BC: the Basic Annals of Zhou on the end of Eastern Zhou, and the Basic Annals of Qin under the first year of King Zhuangxiang, with Lü Buwei's suppression of Eastern Zhou, Meng Ao's campaign against Han and the founding of Sanchuan Commandery.
The row of the Table of the Six States for this year: the entries for Qin, Han and Chu.
The entries of the Hereditary Houses for this year: the house of Lu on its extinction by Chu, and the houses of Yan, Zhao, Han and Qi.
The lines of the Biography of Lord Chunshen on the accession of King Zhuangxiang of Qin, Lü Buwei's chancellorship and the taking of Eastern Zhou.
